Subject: Payment setup & PO kickoff: BlueRidge Supply — remittance and ACH details

Hi Sara —

Welcome and thanks for partnering with Redwood Inference. We want to get BlueRidge set up in our procurement system so we can start issuing POs and paying on schedule. To accelerate the vendor onboarding, could you please confirm the following by end of week?

- Legal entity name (for vendor record / W9)
- Preferred payment method: ACH (US domestic) or wire for the first invoice
- Remittance email address (where we should send remittance advices)
- AP contact and invoice submission method (email vs portal upload)
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing number, account number) — if you prefer, we accept a bank authorization letter or voided check instead of sending account numbers over email
- Any PO formatting requirements (do invoices need PO + line-item IDs)

I'm attaching our vendor onboarding form to capture the fields above (vendor_onboarding_form.pdf). Once we have the completed form and W9, our finance team will create the vendor record and issue the first PO. Standard terms are Net30 unless otherwise negotiated.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sara replies with bank docs and W9
2) Finance (Lauren) reviews and requests verification (micro-deposit or bank letter)
3) Redwood issues test PO and payment; if ACH is verified we continue with recurring payments

Thanks — please loop in your AP team if that's easier.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the detailed note and the form. Quick answers up front:
- Legal name: BlueRidge Supply Co., Inc.
- Preferred payment: ACH for regular invoices; for any one-off large capital orders we typically request wire.
- Remittance email: ap@blueridge.com (cc'd)
- AP contact: Maria Lopez (maria.lopez@blueridge.com, +1 415-555-0123)

Regarding bank details, we prefer not to send raw account numbers over standard email. We can either:
1) Upload a voided check / bank letter to your vendor portal link (recommended), or
2) Send an encrypted PDF to Lauren (if you have an S/MIME or secure link).

Also: could you confirm your ACH verification process? Do you do micro-deposits or a $0.01 authorization? For PO formatting — we can accommodate PO# + line-item codes; if you can share an example that will speed things up.

I'm uploading the W9 and bank authorization to the portal now. If you prefer direct attachments I can send them to Lauren via secure email.

Best,

Subject: Re: Payment setup & PO kickoff: BlueRidge Supply — remittance and ACH details

Hi Sara —

Thanks — that's helpful. A couple of notes from finance so we can close the vendor record:

1) For ACH we require one of the following for verification: a) voided check, b) bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account ownership, or c) successful micro-deposit verification (we do a $0.01 micro-deposit via our portal). We do not accept account numbers in plain email.

2) Please upload the W9 (completed and signed) and either the voided check or bank letter to the Redwood vendor portal here: https://vendors.redwoodinference.com/onboard/BR-portal-verify. If you run into access issues, reply and I'll send an expiring secure upload link.

3) Invoice requirements: please include our PO number on the invoice, invoice date, and one-line item per SKU. Our AP system matches invoices to POs by PO# and line-item codes — missing PO numbers are the most common cause of payment delays. Sample PO examples: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/po-format-examples (see example B).

4) Payment terms: our default is Net30. If BlueRidge has standard terms that differ, state them and we'll escalate. If you'd like to discuss early-pay discount (1% 10), mention it and we can consider.

I've attached our remittance guidelines for vendor reference (accounting_remittance_guidelines.pdf). Once we receive the portal upload, we'll set up the vendor and schedule a verification.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: accounting_remittance_guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)]
